theme: An open Saturday with a pre-Croatia list underneath it.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan, and the girls are still in the house. Croatia is three days out, so a short stack of pre-departure bookings is really what this open Saturday is for.

needsAttention.title: Call the Halloween trip
needsAttention.detail: St Pete or Maine is meant to be decided today. The Oct 18-Nov 1 Airbnb and car both cover Halloween and rebook while you're on the water, so one call settles three bookings.

needsAttention.title: Reach the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: Confirm the Sept 12 boarding time and place and arrange the Sept 19 return transfer. It has to be settled from shore before the charter, where there's no signal.

needsAttention.title: Get the baggage in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site and buy bags online now, before airport rates. Two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on.

needsAttention.title: Two lodging gaps still open
needsAttention.detail: Unbooked: the Sept 19 Cavtat night after the charter, and the Sept 20-21 St Pete nights before Tuesday's pickup. Both need booking from dry land before Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: The 15-minute board sweep at nine. A glance tonight at the Croatia P1s means they get an owner and a date tomorrow, not another week's slip.

flagged.title: A card was added to Apple Pay
flagged.detail: American Express flagged your card ending 3003 added to Apple Pay. Worth a glance if that wasn't you.

flagged.title: A sitter applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Carly M. applied to the job you posted, waiting for a look whenever you're back at it.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promotions: FT, Bloomberg, Responsible Investor, NYT Cooking, a few Labor Day sales, and the daily Todoist digest.
inbox.clear: Nothing personal is waiting on your reply this morning.

resolved.title: The PRI stewardship call is off
resolved.detail: Conor Kehoe's assistant cancelled the Zoom on PRI sustainability and stewardship, so there's nothing to prep for it.

recipe.title: Chestnut and Pancetta Salad
recipe.why: An autumn plate that leans on chestnuts and cool-weather greens just coming into season.

tasks.title: Book the Croatia backup rental car, refundable
Build and pack the travel larder bin
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: The calendar is clear, a rare open Saturday with all four girls still in the house.
Nothing scheduled, so the day bends to whatever you point it at.
Croatia is three days out; the quiet now is the last of it before the trip.
